notes: Generic read-time advisories (X0 S10b). Correction-specific advisories live on the corrections in corrections/<pkg>.json; this file holds the advisories that are not tied to one correction.

applies_to is one of the predicates implemented in gridform_core/result_advisories.py: pre_profile_run (the run recorded no methodology profile), legacy_validation_report (the run's scientific-validation report is not the recomputed v2 schema, e.g. the v1 self-reported report).
Severity high or critical puts every comparison that includes the run into attribution_status needs_review (no causal conclusion).

advisories.title: Produced before the 2026-10 review fixes
advisories.summary: This Run was produced by a VALUE version before methodology profiles and the 2026-10-04 review corrections. Known issues may affect its energy balance, validation status and annual results; its recorded validation status is superseded.

advisories.title: Validation report not independently verified
advisories.summary: This run's scientific-validation report is not the recomputed v2 report (for example the v1 report, which relies on the model's self-reported, compatibility-adjusted residuals); its passed statements were not recomputed from the ledger by the independent energy-balance check.
